title: Dijkstra Algorithm
definition: Finds the shortest path from a source node to all other nodes in a weighted graph with NON-NEGATIVE edge weights. Uses a Min-Priority Queue for O(E log V) time.
simpleExplanation: Google Maps figuring out the absolute fastest way to get from your house to the grocery store, considering traffic and speed limits.

answers.question: **Expert:** Dijkstra's Algorithm (Adjacency List)
